title: I'm starting to get my animation workflow to work
author: LatentBlade

comments.author: LatentBlade
comments.body: Images are generated by Gemini prompts and nano banana. I've been working on my prompts in a jupyter notebook. The input is a character from front, back, and side view. That's the reference for all image calls. I am green screening since Gemini can't do transparency. I'll run the prompts 2 or 3 times.  Then I take the best frames and work them in Krita (which is a new tool to me). I am taking that output and putting it back in nano banana for a consistency check but that.seem worse this week than two weeks. This example has not been through that second pass yet. I think this is going to let me get all my characters good enough.

replies.author: LatentBlade
replies.body: And despite using a bunch of custom code (AI assisted I'll admit) and manually animating these some people will say I haven't made anything.

I can always take an animation and prompt to give me a frame between these later on. I want to get to get a pass of each my characters done and then keep refining.
